title: Amazon's Prime Air drone service, which operates across 18 sites in 10 US states, is drawing local opposition; its Baton Rouge hub launches ~30 drones per hour (Kris Maher/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kris Maher / Wall Street Journal: Amazon's Prime Air drone service, which operates across 18 sites in 10 US states, is drawing local opposition; its Baton Rouge hub launches ~30 drones per hour — Aerial package drops draw plenty of gawkers, but some say they're destroying the neighborhood
